context: Hybrid full-stack operations app: mobile-first shop-floor workflows with a laptop command center for Head of Production

primary_tasks: move a Sales Order through production without losing ownership
complete the next role-specific task in under 10 seconds
surface blockers, approvals, deadlines, and delivery risk
maintain one auditable record across design, payment, print, packing, loading, and delivery
phase_1_discovery.emotional_tone: calm urgency: tactile print-shop warmth with operational precision
phase_1_discovery.theme: light-first, with optional dark mode for low-light production areas
phase_1_discovery.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with Organic & Earthy material cues
phase_1_discovery.design_direction: A production ledger meets a dispatch board meets a print proof wall. Use warm paper surfaces, ink-black text, signal red for exceptions, and a restrained cobalt action color.

references.descriptor: 5-KPI rule, threshold-based green/yellow/red statuses, refresh cadence matched to operator decisions.
Single-column mobile summary, one above-the-fold answer, 48px+ tap targets, visible last-updated state, stale-data banner.
Station dashboards, alarms opening history and ownership, one-tap dispatch, mobile confirmations tied to one operational truth.

references.source: Mobbin delivery flows and Swiggy delivery partner architecture
references.descriptor: Progress indicators, photo/OTP proof, checklist-driven handoff, resilient sync for unreliable networks.

phase_2_research.synthesis: Borrow glanceable shop-floor status from MES dashboards, checklist confidence from logistics apps, and physical proof-board cues from print studios; avoid copying generic SaaS cards.

design_variants.name: Ink Ledger
design_variants.description: Warm off-white paper, black ruled grid, cobalt actions, red exception stamps; best balance of trust and speed.

design_variants.name: Dispatch Signal
design_variants.description: Charcoal shell with white work surfaces and red/amber operational signals; optimized for Head of Production command-center use.

design_variants.name: Print Room Index
design_variants.description: Editorial serif headings, monospace metadata, oversized PO labels and proof thumbnails; strongest for design and quality review.

design_variants.name: Route Card
design_variants.description: Flat blue-grey surfaces, bold route bands, compact driver checklists and delivery proof; strongest for dispatch and drivers.

design_variants.name: Tactile Utility
design_variants.description: Soft sand panels with crisp 1px borders, subtle inset controls, and large thumb-first actions; strongest for helpers and operators.

typography.heading: IBM Plex Sans, 700/500; compact, technical, humanist
rules: Do not use Inter for headings
No pure black or grey; use tinted ink and warm grey
Color is functional: cobalt means action, red means blocked/urgent, amber means waiting, forest means complete
No full-screen gradients; use texture and borders
All text and interactive states must meet WCAG AA, preferably APCA

visual_enhancers: subtle paper grain via CSS pseudo-element at low opacity
ruled grid lines in desktop schedule
stamp-like status badges with crisp borders
layered ambient shadows only on floating drawers
no decorative emoji icons; use lucide-react

grids.mobile: grid-cols-1, bottom navigation or compact header, one primary action per screen, 16px minimum gutters, 48px minimum targets
grids.desktop_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6; primary schedule col-span-2 row-span-2, alerts/feed col-span-1 row-span-2, KPI summaries col-span-1
grids.schedule: desktop table-like ruled grid; mobile stacked order lanes with direct action buttons; never hide PO/outlet/operator context
grids.split_quantities: Each operator assignment is a direct row with operator name, quantity, deadline, status, and audit timestamp; show total assigned vs PO quantity prominently

layouts.navigation: Every page has visible brand, 3-5 desktop links (Today, Orders, Schedule, Approvals, Delivery), role label, and primary action. Use solid warm surface or opaque glass, never transparent.
layouts.mobile_today: Header with date and sync state; urgent strip; role-specific queue; large next-action rows; completed section below; sticky bottom action only when needed.
layouts.head_of_production: Asymmetric command center: KPI rail, production schedule as dominant region, blockers/approvals rail, delivery risk footer. Use dense dashboard mode but retain generous section spacing.
layouts.order_workspace: PO identity and customer/outlet at top; journey stepper; line items; attachments; payment; production split; packing; delivery records. Keep audit timestamps visible.
layouts.permissions: Render allowed actions only, but also show read-only status context. CRM gets progress visibility without mutation controls. Head of Production can edit all.
layouts.empty_states: Explain what will appear and offer the permitted next action; never leave blank cards.

motion.entrance: stagger queue rows by 40ms, respecting prefers-reduced-motion
motion.interaction: specific transitions for transform, opacity, background-color, border-color; 160-220ms ease-out
motion.feedback: status change briefly highlights the updated row; upload shows progress; checklist completion uses a short check animation
motion.loading: skeleton rows matching final layout; show cached data immediately with last-updated label
motion.reduced_motion: disable parallax and stagger; preserve focus and state-change text

accessibility: all interactive and key informational elements include data-testid in kebab-case
keyboard-visible focus ring with 2px cobalt ring
never rely on color alone; pair status with text/icon
announce async upload, sync, approval, and delivery outcomes
confirm destructive or irreversible status changes with Shadcn AlertDialog

media.policy: No stock imagery is required for this operations app. Use user-uploaded design proofs and sample print photos only; render them with object-contain, filename, uploader, timestamp, and approval state. Do not use placeholder image URLs.

3d_libraries.reason: This is a clarity-first production dashboard; 3D would add cognitive and performance cost. Use CSS grain and ruled geometry instead.

integrations.accurate_online: Build a secure backend boundary with OAuth/token storage server-side, sync status, import mapping, idempotency keys, retry queue, and audit logs. Demo orders are MOCKED until credentials are provided; clearly label demo data.
integrations.payments: Internal payment status and approval only; no payment gateway. Payment flow is MOCKED as an internal workflow until backend integration is connected.
integrations.offline: Prefer cached read state with stale banner and queued mutations; never silently claim a sync succeeded.

implementation_for_js.stack: React JS, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, shadcn/ui primitives
implementation_for_js.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox, Form; never native select/date inputs
implementation_for_js.feedback: Use Sonner from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or existing project equivalent
implementation_for_js.charts: Use Recharts/Shadcn chart patterns only where useful; provide text summaries and accessible labels

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: one clear next action per shop-floor screen
show PO number or outlet name and operator, never machine as the primary schedule identity
support three-day standard deadline from PO entry and visibly mark Head of Operations-only urgent priority
model one Sales Order with multiple line items and preserve line-level operator/color/notes data
show progress timestamps and ownership at every transition
avoid generic centered layouts, excessive rounded cards, full-screen gradients, and transparent surfaces
use generous p-6/p-8 inside bordered containers
use flat rectangular dashboard surfaces with subtle borders; reserve shadows for floating elements
all hover states explicitly set text color; all buttons have hover, active, and focus states
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Ink Ledger direction first. Keep mobile Today Jobs as the primary experience and make the Head of Production dashboard responsive rather than a shrunken desktop. Add stable data-testid attributes to buttons, links, inputs, menus, status badges, balances, confirmation text, upload controls, schedule rows, checklist items, and error states. Preserve the Accurate boundary and label demo data and MOCKED payment integration in the UI until real credentials/backend endpoints exist.
